newsitem.title: USA: Stanley Works to unveil restructuring - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Stanley Works to unveil restructuring - WSJ.

text.p: Tool and hardware maker Stanley Works is expected to announce company-wide restructuring Friday that would cut as many as 4,700 jobs, or about 25 percent of its work force.
In Thursday's electronic edition, the paper said that for months Wall Street had been anticipating the move, aimed at revitalising the company's basic tool and hardware business.
The programme is expected to result in a charge against earnings to be announced with second-quarter earnings, the article said.
It is unclear whether the company expects to take the whole charge against second-quarter results, the story said.

The paper cited analysts who said Stanley would consolidate manufacturing operations in part by closing inefficient plants, combine operations to make the most of capacity at modern plants and reduce the number of items it makes.
The company is also expected to cut overlapping administrative functions, the story said.
